name: Shimaisou -II-
source:
"True love doesn't perish."

Houmoku Chikaku's suicide – the year has passed and by January the third semester has begun.

Kagome Seishin Girls Academy is shook by a particular event: The election of the new student council administration team is imminent.

First year student of the Bird Class, Mashiro Hii, is lending a friend, Suoh Tamaki, her supportive hand during the election process.

One day, Hii meets a girl called Tsubaki Tsukumo, the supposed sister of the former student council's vice president Tsubaki Shijuuku who has now disappeared.

In order to seek out the truth, Hii confronts the residing student council president, Rindou Tsui, with the question whether she's the murderer of Houmuku Tooku, the twin sister of the late suicide victim Houmoku Chikaku.

Tsui is ready to let her in on the truth if a certain condition is fulfilled – they agree on a bet. 

A bet about which candidate will succeed in becoming the next student council president. Hii reluctantly accepts.

"Should I win this bet, I want you to fall in love with me."

[Translated with anecdotal information added from the [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ240372.html]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
“真爱不会消逝。”

鸨木近的自杀事件过去一年，时间来到一月，第三学期开始了。

神乐清心女子学院正因一件大事而动摇：新学生会管理团队的选举即将举行。

鸟班一年级学生日比谷真白在选举期间向朋友苏芳环伸出援手。

某天，真白遇见一名叫九十九椿的女孩。她自称是前学生会副会长九十九雫的妹妹，而雫已经失踪。

为了查明真相，真白质问现任学生会长龙胆翠：她是否杀害了鸨木透？透是上一名自杀者鸨木近的双胞胎姐姐。

只要满足某个条件，翠就愿意告诉她真相——两人约定打一个赌。赌下一任学生会长究竟会由哪名候选人当选。真白不情愿地接受了赌约。

“如果我赢了这个赌，我要你爱上我。”
